Why Active Air

Honest Advice From The Person Who Owns The Company

Your call, message and project go directly to Andrew. No call center, no runaround and no getting passed from person to person.

We look at your current system, your comfort concerns and long-term costs, then recommend what makes sense. Not simply the newest or most expensive option.

Every system we install represents our name. We take pride in doing things the right way, not the easy way, and we treat your home like our own.

Andrew spent 18 years on the distribution side helping contractors choose equipment, and still visits manufacturers to learn new technology.

Prices

Straight answers on price

Tune-up prices are fixed and listed here. Bigger jobs get a free consultation and a written quote first.

Safety and combustion checks, burner, flame sensor and ignition cleaning, venting, blower and a full heating cycle. If anything else is needed, we explain it and give you the price before doing the work.

Burner and boiler cleaning with a new nozzle, oil filter and pump strainer, then a check of ignition, safety controls and the whole system. Extra cleaning may be needed if the boiler hasn’t been serviced in three years.

Refrigerant and pressure checks, electrical connections, condenser motor and fan, evaporator coil, condensate drain flush and treatment, and a standard 1-inch filter.

Preventive maintenance for rooftop units up to 10 tons at restaurants, offices and shops. Plus tax; repairs and parts are quoted separately.

Every replacement starts with a free in-home consultation and a written quote, so you know the price before any work starts.
